scope.nominalMethod: Length-weighted midpoint samples <=0.35 mm apart. Nominal contact: XY distance to previous-layer segment <= half the sum of the two commanded bead widths. No extra 0.6 mm support allowance. Actual bead shape and weld strength remain unmeasured.
scope.timing: Commanded feed-limited lower bounds; excludes acceleration, firmware lookahead and heat-up. Travel/retraction time assigned to preceding extrusion layer. Actual completed print timing is unbound.
scope.physical: User reports latest Ender physical failure; photos not calibrated to Z and executed file hash unbound.
